name: MethylExtractor
tagline: Methylation counts from bisulfite BAM files, written as per-chromosome HDF5.
description: MethylExtractor reads a coordinate-sorted, indexed bisulfite BAM and a reference FASTA and writes per-chromosome cytosine counts. CG context is extracted by default; CHG and CHH are optional flags. Each chromosome file stores an HDF5 compound dataset named methylation_data (pos, mC, uC, tnc), preferably with the Zstd filter 32015, plus a JSON sidecar. It is a performance-focused fork of MethylDackel and remains under the MIT license.

features.title: CG, CHG, and CHH contexts
features.description: CG is always counted. CHG and CHH are included with --CHG and --CHH. Both strands stay separate records; positions in the count file are 1-based.

features.title: MAPQ, Phred, and flag filters
features.description: Defaults drop reads below MAPQ 30 and bases below Phred 20, and they omit sites below coverage 4. Unmapped, secondary, supplementary, QC-fail, and duplicate reads are removed, as are reads with an NH tag greater than 1.

features.title: HDF5 methylation_data
features.description: The default output is a chunked compound dataset with fields pos (uint32), mC (uint16), uC (uint16), and tnc (uint8). Compression level 1-19 uses Zstd filter 32015 when the plugin is on HDF5_PLUGIN_PATH, and gzip otherwise. Text and split-by-context files are optional.

features.title: JSON sidecar, manifest, and timing
features.description: Each written count file gets a methylextractor.context_qc JSON sidecar. The run also writes an extraction manifest and a timing document. The tool records metrics and does not assign pass or fail.

features.title: Memory-gated parallelism
features.description: Region threads split each chromosome. --chrom-parallel runs more than one chromosome at a time, largest first, and --max-rss-gb (default 32) holds the estimated resident set of in-flight chromosomes to that budget.

features.title: Read-level patterns and CpG haplotypes
features.description: --read-level writes a sparse per-tile pattern histogram. --mhap writes per-read CpG positions and methylation calls. Marginal count files stay the same.
